item.title: Nike's Beautifully Light, Running-Inspired Air Max Is Already Ready for Summer

item.title: Vans Turned Its Calmest Shredder into a Crazy Thick Clog
item.description: Vans Authentic Foam clog is a slip-on version of the skate house's best shredder. It also really looks like a Crocs clog.

item.title: Thom Browne Says His First Sneaker Collab Could Only Be "With ASICS, of Course" (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Surprisingly, Thom Browne's first-ever sneaker collaboration was with ASICS, maker of technical running shoes. Browne explains why it makes perfect sense.
